message:
I remember the time my grandson asked me about our family emergency plan, and I realized I was the one without an answer. It struck me how often I’d thought about preparedness but never truly put it into practice. So, I gathered my notebooks and started organizing our important documents, packing a few go-bags, and even filling up some water jugs. 

It felt good, really good, to finally be the prepared one for once. It’s funny how a little planning can bring such peace of mind. Have you ever had a moment where you felt ready for anything?
